found_specs.title: Current Finance - Sherlock Contest README (Protocol Design, Invariants, Q&A)

metadata.notes: Website is a SPA (no crawlable content). README.md from contest repository used as primary specification. Protocol: Sui Move lending protocol with exchange rate/ctoken/borrow index model. Key invariants: (1) Users cannot switch emode once obligations created, (2) Only emode assets can be borrowed, (3) Invariants must hold under flash loan with reentrancy in same PTB. Flashloan fees tied to emode. Whitelisted tokens only (LST, standard Sui Coin). Liquidation bots may delay (bad debt possible).
